_note: Prices in silver pieces (sp). SRD 5.1 equipment prices are gp x10. Register prices from the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json win where they exist. Every record carries src.

threshingflail.name: Threshing Flail
threshingflail.desc: A two-handed farm tool. The rhythm is the whole of his method.

candleknife.name: Candle-Knife
candleknife.desc: A dagger that has never been anything else.

mace.name: Mace
mace.desc: 1d6 bludgeoning. Vilar's book price: five gold.

spear.name: Spear
spear.desc: 1d6 piercing (1d8 two-handed). One gold at Vilar's.

threshingflail1.name: Thresh. Flail +1
threshingflail1.desc: Barley's own method, a little more than it was. +1 to hit and damage.
threshingflail1.src: SRD 5.1 (Weapon, +1); the flail per invented.json#threshing-flail; reward invented.json#quest-weapons

threshingflail2.name: Thresh. Flail +2
threshingflail2.desc: +2 to hit and damage. It comes round again.

robes.name: Wizard's Robes
robes.desc: AC 11 + DEX. Sigils in the hem: a wizard's only armor. Mage Armor still works over them.
robes.src: invented (Griz 09-25: something for Aurdin's armor slot); AC as padded

robes1.name: Robes +1
robes1.desc: Wizard's robes +1. The lake gave them back.

chainmail.name: Chain Mail
chainmail.desc: AC 16. Heavy. Stage work outside, honest steel under.
chainmail.src: SRD 5.1; urtusk-children-prerolls.pdf p.6 (Lymen's, from the show-armourer)

ringofbinding.name: Ring of Binding
ringofbinding.desc: +3 to CON saves. On rounds 1, 4, 7 and 10 the thing in the lake must turn on the wearer.

charm.name: Charm
charm.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 33 ('Charms (no promises made) 1 sp to 1 gp')

ringofprotection.name: Ring of Prot.
ringofprotection.desc: Ring of Protection: +1 AC and +1 to saves.

simples.name: Simples
simples.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 9 ('Theriac, purges, simples ~2 sp the dose'); effect invented.json#simples

kit.name: Healer's Kit
kit.desc: Stabilizes the fallen: a KO'd hero gets up at 1 HP.
kit.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 9 (5 gp); SRD 5.1 Healer's Kit (10 uses: 5 sp each here); revive invented.json#kit

antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
antitoxin.desc: Advantage on saves against poison for the fight.

superiorpotion.name: Superior Potion
superiorpotion.desc: Superior Healing: heals 8d4+8. Out of a dead man's cabinet.
superiorpotion.src: SRD 5.1 (Potion of Healing, superior); Winters' stock invented.json#winters-shelves

elixir.name: Elixir of Health
elixir.desc: Cures poison and paralysis on the spot.
elixir.src: SRD 5.1 (Elixir of Health); Winters' stock invented.json#winters-shelves

draught.name: Draught
draught.desc: The House's antitoxin draught. Advantage on saves against poison. One silver at the board.

oil.name: Oil Flask
oil.desc: Thrown and lit: 5 fire. Never under a roost.
oil.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 16 (oil, flask 1 sp); SRD 5.1 Oil

torch.name: Torch
torch.desc: Bright light for the fight. Some things hate it.
torch.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 15 (torches, ten 1 sp); SRD 5.1 Torch

tent.name: Tent
tent.desc: A short rest in the open: everyone heals half, fighters and paladins recover.
tent.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 15 (two-man tent 2 gp); short-rest use invented.json#tent

chalk.name: Warding Chalk
chalk.desc: Draw a threshold line. For a while, fewer things find you.
chalk.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 33 (warding chalk, threshold line); effect invented.json#chalk

rope.name: Hemp Rope
rope.desc: Fifty feet. For hauling things out of water you don't want to enter.

candle.name: Candle
candle.desc: One of Vivian's. It smells of the east side.

bucket.name: Carrion Bucket
bucket.desc: The deep station's bucket. Something below is used to it.

fivetokens.name: The Five's Gear
fivetokens.desc: Gear and leavings off five drowned men. Proof for a book.
fivetokens.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (Pete's five, drowned in the stair)

cloakertail.name: Cloaker's Tail
cloakertail.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §8 (bring the tail to Hessle's board)

batfur.name: Bat Fur
batfur.desc: Giant-bat fur, bagged. A Darkness wants it with a drop of pitch. Percy pays a fifth of what it sells for, rendered.
batfur.src: SRD 5.1 (Darkness: bat fur and a drop of pitch); wiki/vice-row.md (Percy's: road harvest rendered, jarred, priced); invented.json#parts

batwings.name: Bat Wings
batwings.desc: Two leathery wings. Percy won't have them. Marta Venn will cook them.
batwings.src: Griz 09-24 (bat wings Percy doesn't want; Viv's mom cooks them up special)

gulchsilk.name: Gulch Silk
gulchsilk.desc: A skein of spider silk. A Web wants a bit of it.
gulchsilk.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 38 (Gulch silk, the skein 5 sp); SRD 5.1 (Web)

darkmantlehide.name: Darkmantle Hide
darkmantlehide.desc: Raw darkmantle hide. Percy cures it and sells it on at two gold.

crawlerichor.name: Crawler Ichor
crawlerichor.desc: Sealed ichor off a dead crawler. The dose trade's cousin. Handle it with a cloth.
crawlerichor.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 38 (crawler ichor, 'consult DM, the dose trade's cousin'); price seat draft 09-24

glowgland.name: Glow Gland
glowgland.desc: A fire beetle's glands. They glow for days. A Light wants something that shines.
glowgland.src: SRD 5.1 (Fire Beetle; Light: a firefly or phosphorescent moss); invented.json#parts

snaketongue.name: Snake Tongue
snaketongue.desc: A snake's tongue, forked. A Suggestion wants one.
snaketongue.src: SRD 5.1 (Suggestion: a snake's tongue); wiki/glowseep.md (snake tongues, CANON 07-24)

axebeakfeather.name: Axe Beak Feather
axebeakfeather.desc: A long wing feather. A Fly wants one.
axebeakfeather.src: SRD 5.1 (Fly: a wing feather from any bird)

wolffur.name: Wolf Fur
wolffur.desc: A hank of wolf fur. A Lightning Bolt wants a bit of fur and a rod of amber.
wolffur.src: SRD 5.1 (Lightning Bolt: a bit of fur)

batpie.name: Bat-Wing Pie
batpie.desc: Marta Venn's special. Eaten in a fight: +2 CON and +5 HP until it ends.
batpie.src: Griz 09-24 (Viv's mom cooks bat wings: combat usable, +2 CON, +5 HP)

anchorpin.name: Anchor-Pin
anchorpin.desc: A brass pin off a Dominion wagoneer, taken as a trophy at the moot. True word on the Snoot, for Hessle.
anchorpin.src: wiki/the-sisters.md (wagoneers set the anchors at the moot); wiki/the-snoot.md (the Dominion lit it); Griz 09-24 (the listed true word is the Snoot)

wagonorder.name: Folded Order
wagonorder.desc: Out of Amara's strongbox, sealed with a dove: 'Half a dozen before the festival, or you will be disciplined. V.'
wagonorder.src: Griz 09-24 (an order: half a dozen before the festival, signed by the appropriate sister); wiki/the-sisters.md (Viatrix runs the route, Vespera's agent; Vespera keeps the doves)

katbook.name: Katarina's Book
katbook.desc: A finished manuscript in a mender's hand. Book One. Use it to read the first page.
katbook.src: wiki/halfway-inn-and-lake.md (Katarina finished Book One here); serial-castegut/installment-01.md (the first page)

leather1.name: Leather +1
leather1.desc: Leather armor +1. The lake gave it back.

studded1.name: Studded +1
studded1.desc: Studded leather +1. The lake gave it back.

padded1.name: Padded +1
padded1.desc: Padded armor +1. The lake gave it back.

hide1.name: Hide +1
hide1.desc: Hide armor +1. The lake gave it back.

chainshirt1.name: Chain Shirt +1
chainshirt1.desc: Chain shirt +1. The lake gave it back.

scalemail1.name: Scale Mail +1
scalemail1.desc: Scale mail +1. The lake gave it back.

ringmail1.name: Ring Mail +1
ringmail1.desc: Ring mail +1. The lake gave it back.

chainmail1.name: Chain Mail +1
chainmail1.desc: Chain mail +1. The lake gave it back.

splint1.name: Splint +1
splint1.desc: Splint +1. The lake gave it back.

estatepapers.name: Estate Papers
estatepapers.desc: Winters' inventory of a dead man's goods. Androit seals it; Casper Venn values it; it goes back to Winters.

debtpurse.name: Pryor's Debt
debtpurse.desc: A sealed purse out of the Pryor estate. Mical signs the crate off her books; Brennan the smith is owed it.

cord.name: Braided Cord
cord.desc: Three strands, even-handed, patient work. Nobody knows why.

doorshield.name: Door-Shield
doorshield.desc: A Silversands door-warden's shield, rimmed in truesilver. +2.
doorshield.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8 (Lymen's: the Door-Shield, shield +2; the proc RULED 09-26 by Griz: no rule text, just the named item); invented.json#door-shield

crewsack.name: The Crew's Sack
crewsack.desc: A mail shirt, a war-hammer and a ring, pried off a dead family's bones in the Burial.
crewsack.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.4 (the night crews' sack is the party's to return)

asmundhammer.name: Asmund's Hammer
asmundhammer.desc: A Silversands war-hammer +1. The haft is wrapped in newer leather than the rest of him.
asmundhammer.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §10-9 (the heir's wedge: gear on the bodies); invented.json#burial-families

ledgerlamp.name: Ledger-Lamp
ledgerlamp.desc: A dwarven lamp under warranty, from Ingrith. It lights further than a torch, and shows the road's seals: white where whole, red where cut.

truesilver.name: Truesilver Lump
truesilver.desc: A fist of truesilver ore from the seam in the First Lamp seal. The smith will want it.

winnower.name: The Winnower
winnower.desc: Barley's threshing flail, a truesilver head on it. +2. A critical hit knocks the target flat.
winnower.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8 (Barley: flail +2; on a critical hit the target is knocked prone); invented.json#four-items

greyseamknife.name: Greyseam Knife
greyseamknife.desc: A sect blade, ward-knotted, not garrison issue. +2. A sneak attack with it poisons (CON 13).
greyseamknife.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8 (Vivian: dagger +2; a hit with Sneak Attack poisons, CON DC 13); invented.json#four-items

diamond.name: Diamond
diamond.desc: Worth three hundred gold. Revivify burns one.
diamond.src: SRD 5.1 (Revivify, a diamond worth 300 gp); handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §9 (Dagny sells one)

sunshaftstaff.name: Sunshaft Staff
sunshaftstaff.desc: Deepholm-made, the trade clan's first toll paid in a century. +2. Spells cast through it are harder to resist, and its light finds what hides.
sunshaftstaff.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8 (Aurdin: quarterstaff +2, spell save DC +1, Light that reveals the unseen); invented.json#four-items

copperscraping.name: A Curl of Copper
copperscraping.desc: A curl of something copper-coloured, the weight of a coin. It is warm.
copperscraping.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §7.1 (the scraping lifted from the wax-paper); wiki/the-copper-egg.md

sectblade.name: Sect Blade
sectblade.desc: A dwarven shortsword with a ward-knot etched on it. The poison on it is spent.

wardknot.name: Ward-Knots
wardknot.desc: Two of Dvalgarda's ward-knots, cut from the sect's blades.

dvalsymbol.name: A Holy Symbol
dvalsymbol.desc: A plain knot of iron on a cord: the Dormant's. It is still warm from his throat.
